title: Initial Configuration of the Reverse Host
statement: For finite deterministic machines $S$ and $V$ over the Boolean alphabet and any Boolean input word $x$, the initial configuration of the host built from $S$ and $V$ on $x$ equals the loader configuration in state $0$, with input head at position $1$, empty assembly buffer, and assembly head at cell $0$.
replaced: For all deterministic machines $S, V$ and every input $x$, the blank-tape initial configuration of the reverse host built from $S$ and $V$ equals the copy-state loader configuration with empty assembly buffer, input head at position one and assembly head at zero.
